title: HtmlH1
responsibility: Renders the native h1 element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlH1.attributes
inputs.description: Native h1 attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlH1.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native h1 element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlH1
outputs.description: The actual native h1 element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
